content: Melvin-Koushki says that in his commentary on Ibn al-Fāriḍ's Tāʾiyya al-Kubrā Ibn Turka alters the second hemistich of line 619 from ‘his Companions and the Followers, leaders of the faith’ to ‘his children and the holy Imams’, in what seems a specifically Shiʿi fashion.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr on Ibn al-Fāriḍ, Tāʾiyya al-Kubrā, l.619 (SND p.269)
